verdict.rationale: MX is a hosted financial-data connectivity platform. Whether it can be self-hosted is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment. The public OpenAPI spec repository and embeddable Connect Widget SDKs are client-side building blocks, not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
